payload.name: Verify event falls in requested time period
payload.description: When a question asks what event happened during a specified time period (e.g., 'during summer 2023', 'towards the end of August'), verify candidate memory dates fall within that period before answering; reject out-of-window events.
content: When a question asks for an event that happened during a specified time period (e.g., 'in summer 2023', 'towards the end of August'), check each candidate memory's world_start (and world_end if present) against that period before citing it as evidence.
If a candidate event's date falls outside the requested period, do not answer with it; run additional searches for events whose dates are inside the period.
Use the calendar definition of the time period (e.g., summer ends around September 22) and resolve relative dates from the session/memory timestamp when determining whether the event fits.

solves: The agent answered with an event dated October 15-16, 2023, when the question asked for an event 'towards the end of summer 2023', failing to verify the candidate's date against the explicit time window. The abstraction is that any question specifying a time period for an event requires verifying that the cited memory's date falls within that window; this applies to future questions about events in named seasons, months, or relative time ranges, independent of the specific topic or entities.
